scope: Accepted names, historical genus synonym and infraspecific caution for existing canonical Hilaria pair; not specimen/photo identification or nativity audit.
source: Existing canonical Hilaria belangeri and Hilaria mutica learner records

accepted_infraspecifics: Hilaria belangeri var. longifolia (Vasey ex Beal) Hitchc.
records.caution: POWO recognizes two varieties; existing species-level field/source observations cannot be assigned to either variety without specimen evidence. Preserve species-level card.
records.duplicate_homonym_caution: Anthephora belangeri is a homotypic synonym; no second canonical species card.

records.caution: POWO treats Pleuraphis mutica as the homotypic synonym and Pleuraphis as a synonym of Hilaria. Regional floras may use Pleuraphis; retain alias for search, not a second concept.
records.duplicate_homonym_caution: Pleuraphis mutica and Hilaria mutica refer to one accepted species concept under POWO/WCVP.

preserved_decisions: All canonical scientific PASS/FAIL/HOLD/UNRESOLVED fields unchanged
No county-native audit or specimen-level identity assertion
No changes to species/genus cards, photos, installs, Sheets, or Pages
handoff: If source records arrive as Pleuraphis mutica, map as synonym to Hilaria mutica; do not create duplicate. Maintain species-level Hilaria belangeri where variety unverified.
